# tests/fixtures

**Status:** `PLANNED`

Sample artifacts for tests and the demo. All must be **synthetic** (no real participants or client data).

## Planned fixtures
| Fixture | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Mock meeting recording/transcript | Drives the vertical slice and the 90-second demo |
| Over-broad requirement in the meeting | Triggers an INVEST **Small** warning for the remediation test |
| Prompt-injection snippet in transcript | Verifies recorded instructions aren't executed |
| Recorded Gemini responses | Deterministic CI without live API calls |
| Sample Trello board state | Adapter and duplicate-protection tests |

Large media files should be small clips or referenced externally.
